_purpose: Launch-era history-rewrite defence: a cumulative-work floor and a table of hard-coded (height, block_id) pins, carried by the client release rather than by the protocol. See docs/ARCHITECTURE.md section 12, 'Launch checkpoints'.
_not_consensus: THIS FILE IS NOT A PARAMETER SET. Nothing here enters params.ConsensusRoot() and nothing here is covered by the params blake3 that a release announces. That is the point: a checkpoint is edited in every routine release, and if editing one could move the parameter hash then every routine release would fork the network. node/checkpoints/checkpoints_test.go pins that boundary.
_schedule: v1.0.0 none; v1.0.1 (~day 3) height 2880; v1.0.2 (~day 10) height 20160; v1.0.3 (~day 31) heights 40320 and 86400; monthly thereafter. Never pin a block younger than minimum_age_blocks. Past sunset_height no new pin is added and min_chain_work alone carries the floor.
